instruction: Create app/admin/zones/sponsorships/page.tsx in jong-jaroen (c:/Users/PC/Desktop/jong-jaroen). Admin page listing all zone_sponsorships joined with jj_zones and sponsor_packages. Show: shop_id, zone name, package (bronze/silver/gold badge), starts_at, ends_at, status (active/expired/cancelled). Filter by status. Use sbServer(). Dark theme, orange accent. When done trigger back to claude with [DONE] tag.
